title: Korean Won and Money Exchange: Get Better Rates
summary: Learn how much cash to exchange in Korea, where to find better rates, and what to do with leftover won. A few simple choices can help you avoid poor conversions.

slides.title: Carry Less, Exchange Smarter
slides.sub: A little cash goes a long way
slides.voice: Korean won: carry less cash. Exchange smarter.
slides.photo_query: South Korean won currency and cash

slides.title: Exchange A Little At Arrival
slides.voice: Change only enough at the airport for transit, a snack, and a taxi. Rates are usually weaker.

slides.title: Compare City Rates
slides.voice: Licensed Myeongdong changers often offer better rates. Compare boards and keep your receipt.

slides.title: Choose Won On Card Terminals
slides.sub: Pay in won, not your home currency
slides.voice: When asked, pay in won, not your home currency. The rate is usually better.
slides.photo_query: credit card payment terminal in South Korea

slides.title: Use Cash, Spend Coins
slides.sub: Markets and transit top-ups; use coins
slides.voice: Keep cash for markets and transit top-ups. Spend coins before flying; they usually cannot be exchanged abroad.
